comment: SOUL device auth test vector (docs/07-CONNECT-AI.md §6.2, §6.17). TEST KEY ONLY: the private scalar is public. ECDSA signatures are randomized, so `sig` is one valid signature: check that the message bytes match `msg_hex`, that `sig` verifies with `pub`, and that your own signature of the message verifies with `pub`. `sig_other_host` signs the same nonce for another host and must be rejected by the cloud.
